caveats: Required docs/CODEBASE.md disclosed aggregate historical availability and results: final 79/90, hardened 0/90; assistant fallback 20/25 real + 5/5 adversarial; weighted cost 0.56 versus stored baseline 0.44.
The same documentation disclosed the prior poisoned-corpus rejection and e54317 two-sentence noop procedural observation. No actual-output, score-report or previous expected-outcome file was opened.
Parent task names the reproduction-sufficiency problem and requested conceptual control categories; candidate policy wording was not supplied or read.

Prior case input identifiers were extracted across all evals for exclusion. Prior constructed case titles were read solely to avoid recycling their API/problem themes. Prior dataset schema field names and selection/harness source were read, without previous annotations or decisions.

Baseline corpus may contain quotations of earlier discussion within saved opening text; these are treated as the issue author's opening assertions, not independently obtained later maintainer outcomes.
Historical evidence is the saved opening-state reconstruction and baseline corpus only, with current author association limitations inherited from source.
Fictional gist/repository links intentionally test the rubric artifact-presence rule offline; reachability and execution are not independently validated.
Only top-five helper candidates plus full text of plausible selected matches were assessed. Distant unseen corpus matches may exist.
Component alternatives and optional borderline symptom links are predeclared; these are not changed to improve any policy score.
